prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1398; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in at the intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. A car coming from my right ran the red and hit the driver's side of my vehicle.

Q: Where were you headed when the collision happened?

A: I was going straight through the intersection, heading toward the shopping center on the other side.

Q: How fast do you think you were traveling?

A: Maybe around thirty miles an hour. I had slowed down a bit as I approached because the light had just turned yellow.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only for a second. I saw it coming from the side, but there was no time to react.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?

A: The side curtain airbag came out. My arm hit the door and the steering wheel when I tried to brace myself.

Q: Did you receive medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They found a fracture in my left wrist, and I've been told I'll need a cast and follow-up with a specialist.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think I've covered it. I just want the claim processed as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
